stageHelp.plan: Works out which recipes and how many machines make what you asked for, and what comes out.
stageHelp.netlist: Lists every machine on its own: production machines, Gas Dispersing Units with the machines of their zone, the Automation-Core, the outside inputs, the Depot Bus parts and the bricks on them, and the belts and pipes between them.
stageHelp.layout: Puts the machines down one at a time and belts each one to the machines it feeds in the same step, so a position that cannot be wired is never used; then keeps moving machines, rerouting lines and squeezing out empty rows for as long as its time budget allows. Watch it build, then improve.
stageHelp.verify: Checks the finished layout against the game's rules and measures what every machine really does.

entry.title: Design
entry.whereHint: Pick the Core AIC Area and its level; the level sets the square you can build in.
entry.whatHint: Pick products. Say how much: the smallest line that works, as much as fits, or an exact rate.
entry.haveHint: These are the raw materials the line needs. Leave a field empty when you have plenty; otherwise type how many arrive per minute.
entry.buildHint: Fewest machines, or the most output the square allows.
entry.squareUnknown: Square size unknown for this level; 50 × 50 is assumed.
entry.pickProduct: What do you want to make?

intentHint.min: The smallest line that makes it: one machine of the last step, fed properly.
intentHint.max: The biggest line the square and your materials allow.
intentHint.rate: A rate you choose, per minute.

entry.alreadyHave: I already have some intermediate items
entry.noNeeds: Pick a product first; the materials it needs appear here.
entry.dropped: Remove (the line will not be able to make the product)
entry.gasHint: Gas lines need a Gas Dispersing Unit zone.
entry.liquids: I can use liquid machines (pipes, crucibles, pumps)
entry.liquidsHint: Off: only belts and solid recipes are planned.
entry.bannedHint: Recipes on these machines are never used.
entry.pickBan: Which machine can you not build yet?
entry.gatheredHint: Nothing in the factory makes these. Tick one only if you will keep bringing it; otherwise the line finds another way.
entry.mixedLanes: Allow mixed belts into the depot
entry.mixedLanesHint: Several items may share one belt when it ends in the depot.
entry.areaFill: Area budget for “as much as fits”
entry.areaFillHint: Fraction of the square machines may cover (default 0.5).
entry.addOverride: Choose a recipe for an item
entry.pickOverride: Which item should use a specific recipe?
entry.buildAllHint: Plan, lay out and check in one go.
entry.buildFooter: Build plans the line and shows what comes out. Layout and Check follow on the flow.

studio.welcomeHint: Choose where you are, what you want and what you have on the left, then press Build. Every stage on the flow can be rerun with other settings.

paramHelp.seed: The same seed gives the same layout every time. Change it to get a different one.
paramHelp.workers: How many searches run at once. 0 asks the machine how many cores it can spare.
paramHelp.spread_gap: Extra corridor width beyond the pylon-width construction corridor.
paramHelp.spread_widest: The widest gap the search will try. It works its way up from the narrowest.
paramHelp.flow_order: Which end of the production chain the machines are laid out from.
paramHelp.frame_every: How often a picture of the layout in progress is sent to this screen.
paramHelp.shrink_rounds: How many times the finished layout is squeezed: empty lines deleted, sides pressed in, machines pulled toward what they feed.
paramHelp.w_wire: What one belt or pipe cell counts for against floor area.
paramHelp.w_unit: What one splitter or converger counts for.
paramHelp.w_pull: How strongly the line is pulled into the corner of the area.
paramHelp.w_shape: How much a long thin layout is penalised against a square one.
paramHelp.w_over: What reaching past the side of the area costs.
paramHelp.entry_sides: Which borders of the area outside inputs may enter from.
paramHelp.pylon: Which pylon is used to power the line.
paramHelp.route_iterations: How many times contested belts are torn up and routed again.
paramHelp.present_cost: What sharing a cell costs while belts are being negotiated.
paramHelp.present_growth: How fast that sharing cost rises each round.
paramHelp.turn_cost: What a corner in a belt or pipe costs, against running straight.
paramHelp.bridge_cost: What crossing another lane with a bridge costs.
paramHelp.history_cost: How much a cell that has been fought over before is avoided.
paramHelp.spread_attempts: Maximum construction attempts; stop at the first complete routed spread.
paramHelp.spread_slice: Attempts per worker in each deterministic parallel round.
